parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, while inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. Deliveries involve our parcel delivery firm and regional hospital logistics firm customers, and inspections involve our infrastructure inspection firm customer.
